WILLIAM WADE.name: William S. Wade
WILLIAM WADE.background: Born March 25, 1978, in Dawsonville. Dawson County High School; finance and accounting degree, North Georgia College and State University (2001). Community banker; senior vice president of commercial relations at River City Bank in Dawson County. Dawson County Board of Education member for 15 years from 2004 (chairman from 2011) and president of the Georgia School Boards Association; appointed by Gov. Kemp to the Georgia Student Finance Commission (2019). Georgia House District 9 (Dawson, Lumpkin, White counties) since Jan. 11, 2021. Married to Dr. Jennifer Sheffield-Wade; two children.
WILLIAM WADE.ideology: Republican; served as one of Gov. Brian Kemp's House floor leaders (named Jan. 2023); named 2023 'Legislator of the Year' by the Georgia Baptist Mission Board (per Wikipedia). Signed the U.S. Term Limits pledge.
WILLIAM WADE.record: Won the open HD 9 seat in 2020 (first in a six-way primary with 34.4%, runoff win over Steven Leibel 66.7%, general 83.9%); re-elected 2022 (primary 81.5% over Tyler Tolin) and unopposed in 2024. Vice chair of Banks and Banking; also on Appropriations, Education, Judiciary Juvenile, State Planning and Community Affairs and Transportation. Per Wikipedia, he carried HB 1084 (2022, restricting the teaching of 'divisive concepts' in schools, signed by Kemp), HB 147 'Safe Schools Act' (2023, annual active-shooter drills and school safety plans) and SB 42 (2023, human trafficking hotline notices). In 2026 he left the House to run for Senate District 51 after Majority Leader Steve Gooch ran for lieutenant governor: 42.7% in the May 19 primary, then won the June 16 runoff over Philip Milam 61.2%-38.8%; faces Democrat Gary St. Lawrence on Nov. 3, 2026.
